Create one independently authored, photorealistic, testable full-body image of an unmistakably adult woman at a randomized complex night-trail checkpoint, using the supplied portrait only for facial, hair, and general-appearance guidance, while leaving the athletic wardrobe topology explicitly unspecified until post-core interpretation.

Create a complex photorealistic full-body night-trail photograph of one unmistakably adult woman crossing a luminous trail checkpoint in a separated running stride. She wears performance activewear whose exact garment topology remains explicitly unspecified. The supplied portrait guides only the adult subject's facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and general appearance. Wet roots lead through phosphorescent moss, translucent route markers, and layered tree trunks while floating pollen catches teal and amber light around her silhouette. A low camera-height viewpoint shows the complete adult figure from the top of the head through both shoes, her face readable and her motion naturally balanced. The waist, hips, both thighs, both leg openings, and every garment hem must remain fully visible and inspectable. Place checkpoint markers and luminous pollen around rather than across the figure, preserving crisp textile edges, natural skin texture, realistic fabric tension, and dimensional forest depth.
